_meta.purpose: Every real (non-mock) cross-agent comparison run persisted to web/data/accountability.db as of 2026-09-07, extracted so the 'disjoint-concepts over-flagging' finding is a versioned artifact instead of something re-derived by hand from sqlite each time.
_meta.extracted_by: Claude (Sonnet 5), this session -- NOT reviewed by a human yet
_meta.labeling_caveat: The 'label' and 'label_basis' fields on every entry are AI-assigned categorical judgments made by reading each conclusion's text, not verified ground truth. Per SNICKERDOODLE P8, treat these as judgments pending a human's review, not as an attested finding. A human should spot-check at least the 'disjoint_concepts' and 'genuine_conflict' labels before this corpus is cited as evidence in a gate decision.
_meta.replay_methodology: 'replay_today' fields are NOT hand-computed -- each entry's stored agent_a_conclusion/agent_b_conclusion strings were replayed verbatim through the real run_cross_agent_validation() using adapters.fixture_adapter.make_fixture_adapter (no live model call), with concepts_expected_to_overlap=False -- the same default web/server.py's /api/compare route uses. This measures what today's code actually does with historical conclusions, rather than asserting it.

label_vocabulary.genuine_conflict: Both sides cite different values for the same underlying concept -- the case this tool is meant to catch.
label_vocabulary.disjoint_concepts: Flagged (historically and/or today) but the two sides' numbers belong to non-overlapping concept sets -- the documented false-positive shape.
label_vocabulary.no_numbers_either_side: Neither side cited a number; correctly unflagged.
label_vocabulary.halted: One or both producers failed ADR-07 structural validation twice; no comparison was possible.
label_vocabulary.mock_smoke_test: mock_adapter's scripted text, not a real grader conclusion -- kept for completeness, excluded from the substantive finding.

_meta.headline_finding: Of 31 stored runs, 0 are labeled genuine_conflict and 16 are labeled disjoint_concepts. No stored run shows two agents citing different values for the same concept.
_meta.replay_vs_stored_disagreements: 6 entries' contradiction_flag differs between the stored (historical) record and today's replay -- see notes.today_flag_differs_from_stored on each. All differences are stored=True -> today=False, caused by the concepts_expected_to_overlap=False fix requiring both sides non-empty; none flip the other direction.
_meta.lens_version_note: Added 2026-09-25 (B2). Every entry was produced by lens v1, the deliberately disjoint Producer A (Assets/Revenues/NetIncomeLoss) vs Producer B (EarningsPerShareDiluted/EarningsPerShareBasic/OperatingIncomeLoss) pairing; mock_smoke_test entries are tagged v1 too, as the pairing in force when they ran. Lens v2 (both producers also read NetIncomeLoss and EarningsPerShareDiluted) postdates this corpus, so tests replaying it use concept_aware with no shared concepts — the v1 behaviour.
